METHODOLOGY

How ElectionLab works

A transparent educational model inspired by modern probabilistic election forecasting.

1. Polling average

Polls are weighted by recency, sample size, population type and pollster quality. The app converts those polls into a national margin.

2. Fundamentals

You can blend polling with a manual fundamentals adjustment representing economic conditions, incumbency, candidate quality or historical partisanship.

3. Correlated error

Each simulation draws one national error shared by every state, then adds smaller state-specific errors. This prevents unrealistic maps where every state misses independently.

4. Electoral College

State outcomes are translated into electoral votes. The model records win probabilities, medians, ranges and the state most likely to provide the decisive 270th vote.

Important: This is an educational sandbox, not a professional forecast. It is not affiliated with FiveThirtyEight, ABC News, The Economist, or any political campaign.
